experiment: day-by-day walk-forward with strategy formation and frozen replay
motivation: The existing backtest retrains only at season boundaries, so a game on 2024-09-30 was predicted by a model that had never seen any 2024 game -- 2,429 games of in-season information discarded.

design.phase2_replay: seasons 2023-2026, winning strategy FROZEN, replayed day-by-day: predict each day using only prior days, then absorb results
design.why_split: selecting and evaluating on the same data inflates results; phase 2 never informs the selection

phase1_results.note: ALL 8 within 1 SE (+/-0.0107). No strategy separated from the field.

key_findings: Frequent retraining does NOT help. Retraining every 7 days scored 0.5779 vs 0.5790 for retraining once per season. The in-season information the old protocol discarded is already captured by the rolling features, which update every game regardless of when the model is refit.

Selection overfitting is real and measurable. The phase-1 winner beat the baseline by +0.0031; in the frozen replay it LOST by -0.0030. The edge reversed sign, which is the signature of noise, not signal.
Most of the drop is the era, not the strategy. Baseline fell 0.0204 and the selected strategy fell 0.0265 -- both large, so ~77% of the decline is common to any model.

era_effect.interpretation: Team-quality dispersion is falling ~22%. Teams are converging, so outcomes are genuinely less predictable. This is league parity, not model decay, and it caps what any model can achieve.

implication_for_accuracy_target: Higher accuracy is not available from retrain scheduling or recency weighting. Both were tested properly and neither helped. The 2023-2026 ceiling is ~55.9%, below the 56.9% measured on the older protocol, because recent seasons are harder.
value_delivered: This protocol is strictly more honest than the previous one and is now the reference. It also provides a reusable harness: any future strategy can be formed on 2019-2022 and replayed frozen on 2023-2026 to get an un-inflated estimate before shipping.
